title: Escape the Deep Forest: a free survival game in your browser
author: FirmCardiologist3391
selftext:
The game is still in active development, and I'm continuously adding new features, animals, environments, and gameplay mechanics.

I'm especially looking for feedback on:

* Gameplay and controls
* Graphics and atmosphere
* Performance (FPS, loading, browser compatibility)
* Difficulty and progression
* Bugs or anything that feels confusing
* Features you'd like to see

Please don't hold back—if something isn't fun or needs improvement, let me know. Your suggestions will directly help shape the game.

After trying it for a few minutes, please leave a comment with:

* What you liked 👍
* What you disliked 👎
* One feature you think would make the game better

Thanks for taking the time to help an indie developer. Every comment and suggestion is genuinely appreciated!
